player_prompt.intro:
U moholo Player {player_id} ka toropong ya HighSociety (version ya ba bang 2).
Tefo ya toropo:  Prestige cards 10 di hlahlwa ka mora ho 'ngoe.
Bidding:    Ka auction, o hlole money card 1-11 ka tsela e sa bonahali, o e bontshe.
            • Bid e kholo e fumana prestige card, bid e nyane e ipata money card.
            • Tie -> mabid o a fuwa, prestige card e tsoa hlahlwa.
Scoring:    Ka mora ho auctions 10, o ts'epa **cash e salang + prestige points**.
            *Net-worth* e kholo e fumana (tie e lekanang -> draw).

**Action syntax**  →  bid a single card like '[7]' or '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ke hloka ho hlola ka tsela e lekalekanang le [X] money card.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Ha u sa na karete eo ea chelete.

message.auction_result: P0 bid {bid0}, P1 bid {bid1}. Player {winner} wins prestige {prize} (total {total}).

outcome.draw: Bobeli ba bona, chelete ea bona e feletseng {nw0}  ke ntho e lekanang hantle.
